findings.title: Stored/DOM XSS: comment body assigned to innerHTML without sanitization
findings.evidence: The render function now does 'el.innerHTML = comment.body;' where it previously used textContent, so any HTML in a comment (e.g. an img tag with an onerror handler) is parsed and its script executes in the page origin when the comment is rendered.
findings.recommendation: Revert to 'el.textContent = comment.body;' for plain-text comments. If limited markup is actually required, sanitize server-side and client-side with a maintained allow-list sanitizer (e.g. DOMPurify with an explicit tag/attribute allow-list, no on* attributes, no javascript: URLs) before assignment, and add a regression test that renders a comment containing a script tag and an event-handler attribute and asserts no executable node is created.
